root.name: Ruy Lopez: Wormald Attack, Grünfeld Variation
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 a6 4. Ba4 Nf6 5. Qe2 b5 6. Bb3 Be7 7. d4 d6 8. c3 Bg4

overview: After 5.Qe2 b5 6.Bb3 Be7 7.d4 d6 8.c3 White has a Ruy Lopez Worrall Attack set-up with the queen on e2 protecting e4 and the rook coming to d1. Black pins with 8...Bg4, trying to provoke h3 or Nbd2 and develop. White plays Nbd2, O-O, Rd1 and keeps a slow central grip. Quiet, positional with deep Ruy plans.

white_ideas.idea: Build the c3-d4 pawn centre and play Nbd2, O-O and Rd1.
Keep e4 protected by the queen and break with d5 or dxe5.

black_ideas.idea: Develop ...O-O and ...Re8 and hit d4 with ...exd4.
Relieve with ...Na5 and ...c5 to gain queenside space.

typical_structures.structure: Ruy Lopez centre with d4/e4 against e5/d6 and Black bishop pinning on g4.

character.notes: Quiet Ruy Lopez with a queen on e2 and a pin on Nf3; not forcing but with real tension.

structure.notes: The centre is in tension with d4 against e5 and Bg4 pinning the knight.

approach.notes: A recognised Ruy Lopez variation with sound ideas.

level.notes: Requires understanding Ruy structures; moderate theory.
